hypotheses.justification: Choose ε with 0 < ε, ε < δ and 2 * ε < rampLimit using ReferencePath.exists_small_length hδ. The existing proof at width ε gives bounds on [0, τ₀], with 0 < τ₀ ≤ ε. Transfer these bounds to width δ on τ := min τ₀ (ε / 2). Indeed, unfolding ReferencePath.continuation, dampedSlope and ProfileHistories.primitive shows that continuations at widths δ and ε agree whenever p.1 < ε: throughout the integration interval between 0 and p.1, both cutoffs equal 1 by ReferencePath.slopeCutoff_one, so intervalIntegral.integral_congr applies. This equality holds on an open half-space, so Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq also identifies their radialPartial values. The definitions of referenceP1 and referenceP2 therefore give identical A and B on [0, τ], transferring every bound unchanged. This works for every positive δ, however large; τ is positive and ≤ δ, and positivity of A transfers as well, so no zero-denominator exception arises.
